revisions.author: FID Rayhan
revisions.description: The robots read views only: new view V_GTOPAS_CROSSDOCK (TB_H_STG_GTOPAS rows with SYNC_STATUS 1) for XD06 and the parent flow; view definitions added to the Tables.

objective: To make the GTOPAS Crossdock Master (WVJA5204, Depot 01) follow NSP by an RPA: add the part + destination rows that appear in NSP and delete the rows that disappear.

Source data: only V_GTOPAS_CROSSDOCK (rows of TB_H_STG_GTOPAS with SYNC_STATUS 1; read-only DB user), rows of the run (SYNC_DT): [Sync] (Current period), [Re-send last Sync] or the Period Rollover (new Current period, XD05 process 3).
Started by the RPA parent flow: in scenario 1 XD06 runs before XD07 and its result decides whether XD07 starts (refer 4.1).
GTOPAS has no period: it always shows the Current month, so the Next period reaches GTOPAS only at the Period Rollover.
The robot writes nothing back to NSP; the result comes by the notification e-mail.

steps: The parent flow starts XD06 with SYNC_DT and RUN_TYPE (SYNC / RESEND: scenario 1; ROLLOVER). NSP has already set the rows to SYNC_STATUS 1 with this SYNC_DT. Write LOG1.

steps.text: Read V_GTOPAS_CROSSDOCK (read-only DB user): rows with SYNC_DT = SYNC_DT of the run, ordered by P_NO, DESTINATION_CODE.
children: ACTION ADD: Depot 01, P/No., Destination Code, Maker A, Domestic/Overseas 2, TOPAS Order Type 3, Order Transportation Code 2.
ACTION DELETE: the row of P/No. + Destination Code (MT = DEL on the screen).

steps.text: Process every row on WVJA5204 (Depot 01). Write LOG3 per row.
children: A row already in the wanted state (Add of an existing row, Delete of a missing row) counts as OK, so a re-send is safe.
A failed row is listed (LOG4) and the next rows are still processed: GTOPAS rows do not depend on each other.

steps: Return STATUS to the parent flow: SUCCESS when every row is OK, else FAILED with the failed rows. In scenario 1 the parent flow starts XD07 only on SUCCESS.
The parent flow sends one notification e-mail per run (GTOPAS result, and AP POLE result when XD07 ran). Write LOG6 and LOG2. The robot writes nothing to NSP.

items: One Power Automate parent flow per run (CDX_SYNC_PARENT), started by NSP with SYNC_DT (the run) and RUN_TYPE (SYNC, RESEND, ROLLOVER).

Scenario 1 (run with GTOPAS rows: a part becomes Active or Inactive, a destination is added or removed): XD06 GTOPAS first; XD07 AP POLE starts only when every GTOPAS row succeeded. When GTOPAS fails, AP POLE stops: XD07 does not start and the e-mail says FAILED.
Scenario 2 (run without GTOPAS rows: Max Case/Day, Pcs/Case, Case/Day, order type of a destination that stays): XD07 only.
Period Rollover (RUN_TYPE ROLLOVER): XD06 only, for the GTOPAS rows of the new Current period.
Choice of the scenario: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM V_GTOPAS_CROSSDOCK WHERE SYNC_DT = <SYNC_DT of the run> (> 0: scenario 1).

XD06 reads only V_GTOPAS_CROSSDOCK (TB_H_STG_GTOPAS rows with SYNC_STATUS 1): one row per part + destination that appears (ADD) or disappears (DELETE) for the part, whatever the order type. NSP writes the row at the save (SP_STG_WRITE) and sends it with SP_STG_SYNC (Current period) or the Period Rollover.
A Case/Day change or an order type change of a destination that stays writes no GTOPAS row.
Rows of the parts outside the run are not touched.
A failed row is listed and the next rows are processed. The result goes back to the parent flow: FAILED stops AP POLE in scenario 1.
When the e-mail says FAILED, the D/S team clicks [Re-send last Sync] before the next [Sync]: the same SYNC_DT; rows done before are OK again (already in GTOPAS / already gone).

The email holds the result of every target of the run: GTOPAS and AP POLE in scenario 1 (AP POLE 'not started' when GTOPAS failed), AP POLE only in scenario 2, GTOPAS only for the Period Rollover.
One email per run: the retries of the same run send no email; only the final result does.

tables.name: TB_H_STG_GTOPAS
columns: Running number: order of the inserts
Calculation period YYYYMM (GTOPAS has no period: [Sync] sends the Current period, the Period Rollover the new Current). FK1 (P_NO, PERIOD) -> TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE
ADD / DELETE: the destination appears or disappears for the part (any order type). No row for a Case/Day change or for a state GTOPAS already has. File / screen column: Add / Delete (MT = DEL)
Always 01. File / screen column: Depot Code. Default '01'
Part number with "-"; FK1. File / screen column: P/No.
7-digit code, the same in NSP and GTOPAS. File / screen column: Destination Code
Always A. File / screen column: Maker Code. Default 'A'
Always 2. File / screen column: Domestic/Overseas. Default '2'
Always 3. File / screen column: TOPAS Order Type. Default '3'
Always 2. File / screen column: Order Transportation Code. Default '2'
Upload of the Kanban or Export Excel (Log); NULL when SOURCE is not UPLOAD
0 = to send (written or updated by SP_STG_WRITE), 1 = sent (SP_STG_SYNC at [Sync], SP_STG_ROLLOVER for GTOPAS). One row with 0 per key at a time: a new change of the key updates it. Default '0'

Time of the [Sync] click (or of the Period Rollover), the same value for every row of that click: the RPA reads the rows of a run by SYNC_DT; [Re-send last Sync] = MAX(SYNC_DT); Last Sent on the screen = latest value
User of the save / upload, or XD05BATCH
Time of the insert (same transaction as the master update)
User of the save that updated the unsent row, of [Sync], or XD05BATCH (Period Rollover)
tables.description: GTOPAS WVJA5204 rows: a part + destination to add or delete, written by SP_STG_WRITE only when the destination appears or disappears for the part (any order type) and GTOPAS does not have that state yet (one unsent row per key). Sent by [Sync] (Current period) or the Period Rollover (new Current period). Read by XD06.

tables.name: V_GTOPAS_CROSSDOCK
columns: Helper, not written: Run filter ([Sync] or Period Rollover). Source: g.SYNC_DT
Helper, not written: Row of the staging table. Source: g.STG_ID
Helper, not written: Period of the row (GTOPAS has no period). Source: g.PERIOD
MT (DELETE = DEL): ADD = register the row, DELETE = MT DEL on the row. Source: g.ACTION
Depot Code: '01' (also the search condition). Source: g.DEPOT_CODE
tables.description: View (Rows of the GTOPAS screen Crossdock Master (WVJA5204) of XD06). GTOPAS rows of a run. FROM TB_H_STG_GTOPAS g WHERE g.SYNC_STATUS = '1'. The robot filters WHERE SYNC_DT = :sync_dt ORDER BY P_NO, DESTINATION_CODE; the parent flow counts the same rows (scenario 1 when > 0).
